segments.text: Day 173 · OAuth2/OIDC, JWT pitfalls, session design, zero trust।

What: The standard identity/authorization protocols, the common mistakes made with JWTs (no revocation, over-trusting claims), and zero-trust — verifying every request instead of trusting the network perimeter.
How to complete: Explain one common JWT pitfall (e.g.
no built-in revocation) and how you'd mitigate it, then describe what "zero trust" changes about internal service calls.
